pieces: So I was scrolling through the internet one day.
and I came across something I honestly found pretty interesting.
I wanted to understand what it was actually about.
Turns out it's a platform where businesses and brands post different tasks.
and people can participate in those tasks.
There are so many businesses looking for people to engage with their products, content and services.
Bounty basically creates a place where those opportunities can be discovered.
by people willing to complete them.
You can join as a hunter.
and find something that works for you.
Anyway, that's how I discovered Bounty.
I thought it was worth sharing.
you can check it out at earnbounty.com.
